one_liner: Polls real fee data, computes speed tiers, recommends a price for your urgency — and proves it by sending real dust through a cheap window and at the deadline.
what_it_does: This lamp watches live network fees and tells you the cheapest price to pay for the speed you need. It proved the point by sending real dust twice: once cheap through a favorable window, once forced at the deadline — and the cheap one won. Proven by 2 real transactions on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
